notes: THE PREVIEWS ARE THE PANEL NOW. Every swatch and Rune preview in the Panel Editor is drawn by attachOgData — the same function the real panel calls — into the same markup, from the same stylesheet, against this machine's own hardware.…

A preview shows one thing by being the panel with everything else switched off — a state the panel already knows how to be in, and one the user can reach themselves from the About page. No preview-only subsetting was invented, because…

Previews show REAL hardware: the actual CPU and GPU model, the actual battery, the actual volume, brightness, microphone level and power plans. Where a machine has never reported something, the preview says Simulated in its footer rather…

Found while building it: preview iframes have no preload and therefore no IPC at all — every call from one fails. That is the real reason the weather, shortcuts and video previews have always talked to the editor instead of fetching for…
The editor READS the control and media state rather than subscribing to it. Subscribing would have kept a PowerShell reader running for as long as the editor was open, to draw a picture.
